description: Telecomunicações is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Rede de Telecomunicações "As Built" cadastrada no sistema GeoConvias. As camadas de “As Built” das redes de serviços públicos de infraestrutura urbana são oriundas do antigo Sistema GeoCONVIAS operado pelo Departamento do Controle e Cadastro de Infraestrutura - CONVIAS quando este fazia parte da Secretaria Municipal de Infraestrutura Urbana – SIURB, em atendimento ao determinado ... Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Ambiente construído, Energia e comunicação, utilitiesCommunication. The portal shows 2020-10-10 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
